data.name: Force Hook
data.description: Element aether; Type form infusion; Level 3; Burn 2 Associated Blasts force Saving Throw none Your force blast hooks onto its target and drags you adjacent to it. This effect functions as force hook chargeUM, except with the range and damage of your force blast.
